title: Eurostat euro-area HICP flash estimate, October 2026 — published six days after the ECB's 10-29 decision
source: EST: TWO PRIMARIES AGREE ON 2026-11-04, fetched direct 2026-10-20. (1) Eurostat's own September complete release, ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/products-euro-indicators/w/2-16102026-ap, carries the line 'The next flash estimate of euro area inflation with data for October 2026 is scheduled for 4 November 2026' (the same 'next release' field correctly named the 2 October flash a cycle earlier, FT-eurostat-hicp-flash-2026-10-01-1 PASS). (2) The ECB statistical release calendar, ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/statscal/ges/html/sthicp.en.html, re-fetched 2026-10-20: '04/11/2026 15:00 — Flash estimate — Oct-2026', with the October complete release at '18/11/2026 12:00' and the November flash at '01/12/2026 15:00'. Stays estimate on two counts, either sufficient: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for a non-US statistical agency (the siblings eurostat-hicp-flash-2026-10-01 and eurostat-hicp-final-2026-10-16 are filed estimate despite direct primaries for the same reason), and the publication hour is not sourced (see notes). Checked 2026-10-20
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-10-20 by this event's own never-assessed initial research, over the single proposal proposals/eurostat-hicp-flash-2026-11-04.from-ecb-decision-2026-10-29.json, read first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md and now inert (shadowed, left in place). It is the first euro-area inflation print after the ECB's 10-29 decision, which therefore decides without it; it feeds the 2026-12-17 ECB decision, where the terminal-rate question is priced to resolve. THE SHAPE TO WATCH: September printed 3.8% on energy 18.9% (Eurostat 2-16102026-ap), services 3.2%, core 2.5%; the October base is softer still in energy (Oct-2025 m/m -0.2%, Eurostat prc_hicp_mmor) while Brent's September average ran about 32% above August and October-to-date about 11% above September (FRED DCOILBRENTEU), so this ledger pre-computes headline of about 3.9-4.0% (band 3.7-4.2%) on energy of about 21% (band 18.5-23%), with services and core flat at 3.2% / 2.5%. CLOCK CORRECTION to the proposal: it converted the ECB calendar's 15:00 to 10:00 ET; with both zones on standard time by 11-04, 15:00 CET is 09:00 ET, and the hour is the ECB series' stamp, not a sourced Eurostat release moment, so the DATE is the deliverable and the hour is not used. It lands the same morning as ADP and ISM Services (10:00 ET). Impact LOW and symbols empty, deliberately and unchanged: no tracked name carries euro-inflation exposure and no house playbook is rates- or euro-keyed. Filed estimate; it widens caution and licenses nothing.
